title: Flight Lieutenant L Cumberworth and Flying Officer J Easdale - Handley Page Halifax LL362
memorial_details: description: ROYAL AIR FORCE/ THIS PLAQUE IS PLACE IN MEMORY AND GRATITUDE TO/ (name)/ AGED 24 YEARS/ (name)/ AGED 24 YEARS/ WHO SACRIFICED THEIR LIVES AVOIDING HOUSES/ IN SWANLAND IN A HALIFAX BOMBER/ WHICH CRASHED ON 2ND SEPTEMBER 1944./ "WE WILL REMEMBER THEM"
